name: migration-to-gcp
description: AI-powered migration assistant with skills for migrating AWS and Azure workloads to Google Cloud Platform (`aws-to-gcp`, `azure-to-gcp`). Discovers existing infrastructure, maps services to GCP equivalents, estimates costs from live Cloud Billing Catalog data, and generates Terraform + migration artifacts. Designed to be used alongside google/skills (https://github.com/google/skills); install via `npx skills add google/skills` to unlock canonical GCP service guidance during the Design and Generate phases.

google_dev_knowledge_api_key.title: Developer Knowledge API key (optional)
google_dev_knowledge_api_key.description: Failover auth for the google-developer-knowledge MCP server when gcloud ADC is unavailable. Create one with: gcloud services api-keys create (restricted to developerknowledge.googleapis.com).

google_cloud_project.title: Google Cloud project ID (optional)
google_cloud_project.description: Quota project sent as X-goog-user-project on ADC-authenticated Google API calls. Defaults to the active gcloud project when unset.
